summary.headline: Planetary Natures and Fortunes
summary.text: Discussion of planetary qualities and fortunes in judicial astrology: Saturn, Mars, and the Sun are hot or dry and malefic, while Jupiter and Venus are benefic, with the Moon’s moisture varying by waxing and waning light. Mercury follows its zodiacal place; the lunar nodes, Caput Draconis and Cauda Draconis, receive natures like Jupiter and Saturn, followed by discussion of planetary masculinity.
